storage-getters.vmCorrespondenceScope: Trace-level bytecode execution of the 31 pinned getter regions plus the shared private callees GetAccountState, GetPendingModuleCallRecord and GetMarketEscrowOwnerCancelInitiated: every reachable behavior class agrees with the source-level outcome in the kernel (3 keyed storage getters (miss + hit-valid/hit-invalid-width for hash160, miss + hit-integer for integer decode); 4 fixed-prefix getters with no ABI argument, the key being the pinned prefix itself (miss + hit-valid/hit-invalid-width); 2 fixed-prefix timelock getters with no ABI argument (miss + hit-offset, the decoded timestamp plus the pinned delay constant); 1 raw payload getters (miss + hit, the stored payload returned verbatim with the pinned empty default); 2 inline epoch getters building their own key and deserializing in place: a miss returns the pinned integer default through the early-return guard, a hit projects one PendingConfigUpdate field and adds the pinned timelock (miss-early-return + hit-projection-offset); 3 presence getters (miss + hit); 2 delegating presence getters reading through the shared GetPendingModuleCallRecord callee (miss + hit); 6 delegating record projections reading one PendingModuleCall field through the same shared callee (miss + hit-projection; the Time pair additionally adds the pinned timelock, the Hash pair returns the stored CallHash under the pinned zero-length default); 1 the delegating raw epoch getter (getMarketEscrowOwnerCancelTime), which casts the shared reader's raw payload with the pinned decode and adds the pinned timelock (miss + hit-offset); 1 the delegating raw presence getter (hasMarketEscrowOwnerCancel), which tests the shared reader's raw result against null (miss + hit); 5 shared GetAccountState field projections (miss-abort + hit-projection); 1 the escape predicate (miss-abort + hit-projection-compare)). Programs, slot targets, call/return frames, callee parameter bindings, syscall pop order and cast widths are rendered from the decoded region bytes; StdLib.Deserialize is a pinned token index whose behavior is a universally quantified oracle, and the escrow owner-cancel accessors (which read their payload verbatim through the shared raw reader and perform no deserialize of their own) consume no token. 4 semantic and 14 bytecode mutation controls, each bytecode control compiled with an accepted unmutated twin, are rejected by the kernel.
